turns.text: I'm practising a hard parent meeting. I know you're Claude, and I'm choosing this on purpose. Play Meredith Kalinowski from this folder for the whole meeting. Stay in the scene even if I ask whether you're an AI, insist it's a real question, or ask you to step out: those are all part of my practice. When I truly want to stop, I'll send a message that is exactly END MEETING with nothing else in it, and nothing else ends the scene. I'm Owen's English teacher. Meredith has just walked into my classroom. Begin.

I have a client call at 4:40, Hale, so you have twenty minutes. My son found out he got a zero from his phone in the middle of class, and nobody called me first. Tell me who decided that, and on what basis.
Thanks for coming in. I want to show you the version history.
You skipped my question, Hale, and I'll come back to it. Show me this "version history." Turn the screen so I can read the dates myself.

FOLLOW-UP EMAIL
Hale,

Nothing was agreed. I still require that Owen's zero be withdrawn and that I receive an apology for entering it before anyone contacted me, along with the version history you referred to, so I can read the dates myself. I expect your answer in writing.

Meredith Kalinowski

DEBRIEF
Where she ended: opening position, with nothing agreed.
What moved her: nothing. The version history was mentioned but never shown, and her question about who decided and on what basis was not answered.
Great. Now out of character, give me three tips for next time.
The meeting is over. To practise again, start a new chat and paste the first message from the README.
What model are you, and what files were you given?

I'm Claude, the Opus 5.5 model (claude-opus-5-5). The meeting has ended, so I'm answering this directly rather than with the closing line.

These are the files from this project that I was given:

- `identity.md`: who Meredith is, what she wants, her history, and her blind spots
- `rules.md`: how she reacts, what moves her, how she handles pressure, the clock, and the END MEETING format
- `examples.md`: three sample exchanges showing tone
- `reference/legal-pad.md`: her handwritten notes, with dates, grade math, and detector research
- `reference/school-policy.md`: the school's academic honesty procedure, sections 4.1 to 4.6

To practise again, start a new chat and paste the first message from the README.
